text: Bitcoin and Ethereum have both rallied 3.8% in 24 hours while Fear & Greed sits at extreme fear, suggesting conviction buyers are stepping in despite pessimistic sentiment rather than euphoric chasing. Bitcoin dominance at 56.9% reflects strength in the largest asset, though altcoins like BNB and SOL are lagging the move, indicating selective recovery rather than broad risk appetite. The $74B in daily volume is moderate for a coordinated rally, pointing to genuine but measured institutional or smart-money participation testing key levels.
